observed_problem.finding: The base Distillery reviewer received candidate JSON but not the candidate-cited source chunks. Acceptance used intrinsic/GRF/project/novelty scores without an evidence-entailment predicate, and accepted source chunk text was then erased.

changes: Require candidate source_ids and reject missing, out-of-boundary, missing-text or hash-mismatched cited evidence before reviewer network calls.
Pass exact bounded cited source chunks to reviewers as explicitly untrusted quoted data.
Require evidence_support, supported_source_ids and unsupported_claims in reviewer output.
Reject high-quality/plausible candidates when evidence support is below threshold, unsupported claims remain, or reviewers cite an unknown source id.
Persist accepted packets as REVIEWED_RESEARCH_HYPOTHESIS with fact_credit=0.
Retain exact bounded cited evidence text plus its SHA-256 in packet metadata for auditability; purge uncited accepted-cycle source rows.
Preserve existing FREE_ONLY provider admission, panel requirements and stricter fallback quality thresholds.

cases: missing citations reject before reviewer call
high quality but unsupported material claim rejects
reviewer-supported source id outside the cited set rejects
supported hypothesis is admitted with fact_credit=0 and exact cited evidence retention
source prompt-injection text is carried only inside an explicit untrusted-data boundary
regression.first_run_note: The first isolated run produced 5/6 because the prompt-injection test asserted one sentence without allowing its source newline; the assertion was made whitespace-robust and the complete six-test set then passed.

counterhypothesis: The existing multi-reviewer panel plus source metadata hashes was already sufficient because reviewers could judge plausibility and the synthesizer saw the source chunks.
adjudication: COUNTERHYPOTHESIS_REJECTED_AT_SOURCE_SCOPE: reviewer inputs did not include source text, no entailment field gated acceptance, and source hashes alone cannot establish that a model-generated claim is supported by the hashed content.
next_exact_action: Re-enter current main, open/fuse this nonduplicate source repair, then execute the exact current Distillery entrypoint regression plus one successor-aligned Forge->Distillery accepted-evaluation flow on an authorized zero-cost runtime. Acceptance requires a Distillery packet with REVIEWED_RESEARCH_HYPOTHESIS, fact_credit=0, supported_source_ids bound to retained hash-auditable evidence, and a negative unsupported-claim control that produces zero accepted dataset tokens.
